fields.label: Deployment Key
fields.description: A unique identifier for this deployment, used as the document name.

fields.label: Deployment Name
fields.description: A human-readable name for this deployment (e.g., 'Jev 1.13'). Bare model name, matching AI Model's convention -- provider is its own field, not appended here.

fields.label: Canonical Decision Model
fields.description: The canonical decision model this deployment realizes.

fields.label: AI Model
fields.description: The AI Model row for this provider and model. Must have modality 'Decision'.

fields.label: Provider
fields.description: The AI Provider for this deployment, automatically populated from the selected AI Model.

fields.label: Provider Model ID
fields.description: The model identifier at the provider, automatically populated from the selected AI Model.

fields.label: Wire Protocol
fields.description: The transport protocol used to communicate with this deployment. 'systemone' for System One protocol, 'openai_chat_json' for OpenAI-compatible chat format.

fields.label: Endpoint Path
fields.description: The API endpoint path relative to the provider's base URL (e.g., '/v1/systemone'). Must start with '/'.

fields.label: Adapter Override
fields.description: Override the backend adapter ID from the model family. If empty, uses the family's adapter_id. Must be registered in the decision backend registry.

fields.label: Latency Budget (ms)
fields.description: Optional timeout in milliseconds for decision calls using this deployment. Overrides surface-level defaults when specified.

fields.label: Enabled
fields.description: Whether this deployment is available for use. Disabled deployments are excluded from resolution chains.

fields.label: Default for Model
fields.description: Mark this deployment as the default for its decision model. Only one deployment per model should be marked as default.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Priority order for failover (lower values = higher priority). Used when the default deployment is unavailable.

fields.label: Supports Select
fields.description: Whether this deployment supports 'select' question type (choose one from options).

fields.label: Supports Judge
fields.description: Whether this deployment supports 'judge' question type (yes/no decisions).

fields.label: Supports Score
fields.description: Whether this deployment supports 'score' question type (ranked scoring).

fields.label: Supports Parallel Questions
fields.description: Whether this deployment can process multiple questions in parallel.

fields.label: Supports Probabilities
fields.description: Whether this deployment returns probability distributions for answers.

fields.label: Supports Confidence
fields.description: Whether this deployment returns confidence scores.

fields.label: Input Modalities
fields.description: JSON array of modality keys supported by this deployment.

fields.label: Context Limit Override
fields.description: Override the context limit (in tokens) for this deployment. Empty = use model family default.

fields.label: State Limit Override
fields.description: Override the state limit (in tokens) for this deployment. Empty = use model family default.

fields.label: Pricing Override
fields.description: JSON object overriding pricing for this deployment (keys: input_per_million, output_per_million). Empty = use model family defaults.

fields.label: Input Price / Million
fields.description: Cost per million input tokens for this deployment (USD). Populated from pricing_override or model family.

fields.label: Output Price / Million
fields.description: Cost per million output tokens for this deployment (USD). Populated from pricing_override or model family.

fields.label: Provider Rate Limits
fields.description: JSON object with provider rate limits (e.g., requests_per_minute, tokens_per_minute). Used for backoff and budget checks.

fields.label: Provider Metadata
fields.description: Additional provider-specific metadata (e.g., max_retries, custom headers). For future extensibility.

fields.label: Health Status
fields.description: Last known health status of this deployment (healthy, unhealthy, degraded). Updated by health checks.

fields.label: Last Healthcheck
fields.description: Timestamp of the last health check performed on this deployment.
